findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment: The bottom of the coolers holding milk are observed to have a slight accumulation of soil residue on them. This was discussed with the PIC. Ensure that nonfood contact surfaces of equipment are cleaned as often as necessary to maintain them clean.
findings.citation_text: 4-602.13 Nonfood-Contact Surfaces. NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.
